description:
Good Bru changes the game in gut health!

Good Bru is the perfect addition to your daily routine for optimal gut health!

Good Bru is a keto friendly functional organic synbiotic that works in coffee or other beverages and food. Made with two high-quality ingredients: organic inulin and patented GBI-30 probiotic. With 1 billion CFUs per serving and 4g of organic soluble fiber, Good Bru is a convenient way to optimize your gut health.

GBI-30 is a strain of bacillus coagulan that survives in hot beverages like coffee, making it the perfect probiotic to mix into your morning cup of joe without effecting the flavor or consistency. With 75 servings per container, Good Bru is a cost-effective alternative to other less effective probiotic supplements.

Good Bru isn't just for coffee lovers! It can also be mixed into other food and beverages, giving you the flexibility to incorporate it into your daily routine in whatever way works best for you.

So why should you choose Good Bru? Because it provides you with the perfect balance of prebiotic soluble fiber and probiotics, essential for promoting good gut health. And with its delicious taste and convenient packaging, it's never been easier to improve your overall wellbeing.

So why wait? Try Good Bru today and give your gut the love it deserves!

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

Backed by over 25 published clinical studies and over 45 published scientific papers to:

Support protein absorption by up to 20% (athletic muscle recovery) (protect against age-related muscle loss)

Support digestive health (fight GERD/acid reflux) (fight IBS) (fight IBD) (rebalance gut microbiome) (fight gastritis) 

Support immune function (fight colds) (help with chronic disease) (reduce inflammation)

Prebiotic soluble fiber may help with controlling blood pressure, cholesterol, and blood sugar as well as increase mineral absorption.

Get rid of the supplements and add Good Bru to your routine! Good Bru is a functional synbiotic that does not affect the flavor or consistency of your favorite beverage.  Get your organic soluble fiber and probiotic everyday all in one at a more affordable price than supplements.  Better quality at a better price.  Good Bru goes great in hot or cold foods like oatmeal or yogurt as well as in beverages like water or juice.  GBI-30 probiotic survives in coffee where other probiotics would not and it germinates in the acidic environment of the gut. Most soluble fiber supplements are not organic and many contain wheat dextrin.  

Pro means positive. Biotic means living! From athletes to the elderly a healthy gut is essential for a good life. The active probiotic in Good Bru (Bacillus coagulans GBI-30) is backed by over 25 published papers showing it to significantly improve health metrics in multiple categories from digestive function to immune health to musle recovery. Having the ability to survive in coffee combined with an organic prebiotic fiber we get a truly Good Bru that will benefit us at any stage in life. 

Can your probiotic do that? Where probiotic supplements fail, Good Bru shines. Not only does the probiotic used in Good Bru have a protective shell allowing it to survive in hot coffee, but it also germinates perfectly in the acidic environment of the gut. Our probiotic has passed the scientific rigors of achieving GRAS status. This means that Good Bru is a functional food, not a supplement!
